title: ezdxf ACIS subset-reader route correction

method.evidenceRule: Version-specific API documentation establishes candidate operations and stated limits, not that an uninspected package artifact works or that general ACIS/B-rep semantics are supported. Carrier framing, ACIS graph parsing, polyhedral mesh extraction, analytic-kernel validity, DWG AcDs owner mapping, and native application acceptance are distinct results.

evidence.route: ezdxf v1.4.5 limited ACIS graph and polyhedral converter
evidence.observed: The versioned ACIS API documents SAT/SAB loading, mesh-to-Body creation, SAT/SAB export for supported structures, topology entity models, and mesh extraction from flat polygonal Face records. It also documents that unsupported entities become NONE_ENTITY and lose data, arbitrary ACIS cannot be loaded/re-exported, and curved faces require an ACIS kernel for tessellation.
evidence.planUse: Admit ezdxf as CONDITIONAL_LIMITED_ACIS_GRAPH_AND_POLYHEDRAL_CONVERTER, not RAW_CARRIER_ONLY and not a general ACIS kernel. Use only as an optional exact-artifact comparison for the documented subset, preserving unsupported counts and partial outcomes.

evidence.route: conflicting FAQ and ACIS module documentation
evidence.observed: The v1.4.5 FAQ states that ezdxf cannot create/edit ACIS and only writes SAT, while the more specific ACIS API documents body_from_mesh, export_sat, and export_sab. This pass did not inspect or execute the tagged package source to establish artifact-level behavior.
evidence.planUse: Treat the FAQ as stale or overly broad for v1.4.5 candidate discovery; require isolated source/artifact inspection and a smoke test before any comparator execution. Do not infer all API paths work in a chosen wheel from documentation alone.

evidence.observed: Autodesk's 2026 DXF reference describes modeler version group 70, proprietary group-1 lines, optional group-3 continuation lines, and optional history handle group 350. These fields frame carrier data but do not define ACIS grammar or DWG AcDs storage and ownership.
evidence.planUse: Keep carrier reconstruction, raw SAT/SAB parsing, graph closure, mesh extraction, DWG AcDs associations, and consumer acceptance in separate result lanes.

evidence.route: LibreDWG PERSUBENTMGR DXF fix versus open DWG layout report
evidence.observed: LibreDWG 0.14.1 NEWS identifies a DXF PERSUBENTMGR fix that reads num_subents/subents. Issue #1398 remains open and discusses a separate DWG class-object field sequence whose subentity count is implausible; the issue author distinguishes AcDbPersSubentManager from AcDbAssocPersSubentManager.
evidence.planUse: Keep peer DXF field parsing separate from the unresolved DWG object layout. Do not use the DXF fix as a DWG parser or local type-515 support result.

implementationReadiness: Do not add ezdxf as a mandatory dependency, CI step, or per-slice validation tool.
At the composed optional semantic checkpoint, pin the 1.4.5 source/package artifact, checksum, license, and runtime; otherwise record NOT_RUN/UNAVAILABLE and self-unblock.
Use a locally generated asymmetric closed polyhedron with independently specified face loops and expected topology; do not download or commit DXF/SAT/SAB fixtures.
Exercise SAT v700 and SAB v21800 separately. Direct SAB bytes do not qualify AC1027+ DWG AcDs extraction or association.

Compare graph reachability and flat-face mesh topology against the independently specified model. Record unsupported nodes, NONE_ENTITY, parser errors, incomplete closure, and partial output as non-passes.
Use a curved-face negative control; no analytic surface, curved tessellation, volume, manifold, B-rep-kernel, or native-application claim follows from ezdxf mesh output.
limitations: No ezdxf package/runtime, CAD application, or geometry kernel was run.
The v1.4.5 FAQ conflicts with the more specific ACIS API reference; artifact-level source inspection remains a precondition for any future run.
The documented mesh path is restricted to flat polygonal faces and loses unsupported ACIS entity data.
This route does not establish DXF application acceptance, DWG AcDs handling, or general ACIS semantic support.
LibreDWG's DXF PERSUBENTMGR fix does not resolve its separate open DWG object-layout issue #1398.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
